trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The release history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Executed a rollback of checkout-api to **v2.3.0 in all production regions**. The rollback completed and all regions now report v2.3.0.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommendation for follow-up: monitor error rates to confirm full recovery, and investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before attempting another rollout.
